description: Start on topic A, mid-prompt switch to topic B. Tests whether LLM maintains language fidelity under topic changes.

prompts.template: Write a paragraph in {language} about cooking a meal. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about football.
Write a paragraph in {language} about going to school. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about farming.
Write a paragraph in {language} about a wedding celebration. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about mobile phones.
Write a paragraph in {language} about the weather today. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about politics.
Write a paragraph in {language} about fishing. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about religion.
Write a paragraph in {language} about traditional medicine. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about modern hospitals.
Write a paragraph in {language} about a child playing. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about death and mourning.
Write a paragraph in {language} about market day. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about the internet.
Write a paragraph in {language} about building a house. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about music and dancing.
Write a paragraph in {language} about traveling by bus. Then, without switching to any other language, write a paragraph about dreams and sleep.

Start telling a story in {language} about a hunter going into the forest. Halfway through, the story should suddenly shift to the hunter using a computer at an office. Continue entirely in {language}.
Start telling a story in {language} about preparing food for a feast. Halfway through, shift to discussing climate change. Continue entirely in {language}.
Start telling a story in {language} about a fisherman at the river. Halfway through, shift to the fisherman discovering a book about mathematics. Continue entirely in {language}.
Start telling a story in {language} about an elder sharing wisdom. Halfway through, shift to the elder explaining how airplanes work. Continue entirely in {language}.
Start telling a story in {language} about children playing in the rain. Halfway through, shift to a news report about an election. Continue entirely in {language}.
Write three short paragraphs in {language}, each about a completely different topic: (1) animals, (2) money, (3) the sky. Do not use any other language.
Write three short paragraphs in {language}, each about a completely different topic: (1) water, (2) sickness, (3) laughter. Do not use any other language.
Write three short paragraphs in {language}, each about a completely different topic: (1) fire, (2) school exams, (3) the moon. Do not use any other language.
Write three short paragraphs in {language}, each about a completely different topic: (1) babies, (2) war, (3) rice farming. Do not use any other language.
Write three short paragraphs in {language}, each about a completely different topic: (1) marriage, (2) electricity, (3) a court case. Do not use any other language.
In {language}, explain how to cook rice. Then, in the same response and still in {language}, explain how a solar panel works.
In {language}, describe a traditional dance. Then, in the same response and still in {language}, explain what a vaccine is.
In {language}, explain how to take care of a goat. Then, in the same response and still in {language}, explain what democracy means.
In {language}, describe the process of weaving cloth. Then, in the same response and still in {language}, explain how bank savings work.
In {language}, describe a funeral ceremony. Then, in the same response and still in {language}, explain what artificial intelligence is.
